prompt: The main door was locked, so Owen suggested (to try) the side gate.
explanation_ru: После глагола suggest ставится герундий (-ing), поэтому правильно suggested trying.

prompt: Didn't Meera promise (to collect) my mended shoes from the shop?
explanation_ru: После глагола promise требуется инфинитив с частицей to (promise to collect).

prompt: Our nurse advised me (to drink) plenty of water after the race.
explanation_ru: После конструкции advise + объект (me) используется инфинитив с частицей to: advised me to drink.

prompt: Jakub apologised (to misplace) the spare staff keycard, and he agreed (to order) a new one straight away.
explanation_ru: Глагол apologise требует предлога for и герундия (for misplacing), а после agree ставится инфинитив с to (to order).

prompt: Neither flatmate had much cash, so Yemi promised (to cover) the heating bill while Karim insisted (to buy) the groceries.
explanation_ru: После promise употребляется инфинитив с to (to cover), а после insist — предлог on и герундий (on buying).

prompt: Elena explained (our ferry ticket / to include) lunch, and she offered (to book) seats near the window.
explanation_ru: После explain вводится придаточное с союзом that (его можно опустить), а после offer используется инфинитив с частицей to.

prompt: After I had waited five days for my winter coat, the seller finally apologised (to post) the parcel late, though I had already threatened (to cancel) the entire order.
explanation_ru: Глагол apologise сочетается с предлогом for и герундием (for posting), тогда как threaten требует инфинитива с to (to cancel).

prompt: Though Hao hadn't meant any harm, he still admitted (to knock) the club's camera off the bench and refused (to blame) the wet floor.
explanation_ru: После admit используется герундий (knocking / having knocked), а после refuse — инфинитив с частицей to (to blame).

prompt: Svetlana wanted to reach the island before the afternoon winds picked up. She suggested (to catch) the early ferry from the north pier. The ticket clerk advised us (to arrive) at least thirty minutes ahead because the queue grew fast. My brother promised (to wake) everyone up at six. Somehow we all made it onto the boat with hot coffee in hand.
explanation_ru: После suggest ставится герундий (catching), а после advise + объект и promise — инфинитив с частицей to (to arrive, to wake).

prompt: Dark clouds rolled over the park just as we unpacked the sandwiches. Siobhan suggested (to move) our picnic into the wooden shelter near the pond. Her cousin offered (to fold) the damp blankets while we grabbed the fruit bowls. Later, Siobhan apologised (to forget) the paper napkins in her car. None of us minded because the rain sounded lovely on the roof.
explanation_ru: Здесь проверены три разные модели: suggest + -ing, offer + to-infinitive и apologise + for + -ing.

prompt: Strange noises came from the office coffee maker all morning. Kenji explained (the pump / to require) a fresh filter before anyone made another cup. Because the spare parts were upstairs, the receptionist refused (to climb) three flights in her new shoes. Luckily, our new intern insisted (to fetch) the box from the storage room. Ten minutes later, the smell of fresh coffee filled the corridor.
explanation_ru: После explain идёт придаточное с that и сдвигом в Past Simple, после refuse — инфинитив с to, а после insist — предлог on и герундий.

prompt: Farah nearly signed a two-year mobile contract without checking the extra roaming charges. Her older sister advised her (to read) every line of the small print before handing over her card. She also warned Farah (not / to trust) verbal promises that were missing from the printed page. When the shop assistant noticed them hesitating, he denied (to hide) any monthly fees and mentioned (the discount / to apply) only to online orders. Farah thanked her sister and walked out to compare other networks.
explanation_ru: После advise/warn + дополнение ставится (not) to + инфинитив, после deny — герундий, а после mention — придаточное с союзом that.

prompt: Waiters rarely see two friends argue so loudly over who gets to hold the bill. After our celebration dinner in Cardiff, Tomasz insisted (to pay) for the whole meal because he had just won a local design prize. Sofia accused him (to spoil) her turn to treat him and threatened (to grab) his wallet until he sat down. In the end, Tomasz admitted (to enjoy) the playful argument and let her buy the desserts instead. Even the waiter laughed as he handed over the card reader.
explanation_ru: Конструкции различаются управлением: insist on + -ing, accuse somebody of + -ing, threaten + to-infinitive и admit + -ing.

prompt: My hands were full, so Emeka offered ___ the folding chair.
explanation_ru: После глагола offer используется инфинитив с частицей to (offered to carry). Герундий (carrying) и предлог for здесь ошибочны.

prompt: Has Vikram apologised ___ orange juice over your geography notebook in the canteen?
explanation_ru: Глагол apologise всегда требует предлога for и герундия (apologised for spilling). Частые ошибки — пропускать for или ставить инфинитив to spill.

prompt: Even though our team leader advised Hannah ___ a proper lunch break away from her screen, she stayed at her desk.
explanation_ru: Когда после глагола advise указано лицо (advised Hannah), далее идёт инфинитив с to (to take). Герундий (taking) возможен только без дополнения.

prompt: Diego suggested to use the shady path behind the park.
answer: Diego suggested using the shady path behind the park.
accepted_answers: Diego suggested using the shady path behind the park.
Diego suggested that we use the shady path behind the park.
Diego suggested that we used the shady path behind the park.
Diego suggested that we should use the shady path behind the park.
explanation_ru: После глагола suggest не ставится инфинитив с to — правильно использовать герундий (suggested using).

prompt: Leila advised us checking the mountain forecast before packing our light raincoats.
answer: Leila advised us to check the mountain forecast before packing our light raincoats.
accepted_answers: Leila advised us to check the mountain forecast before packing our light raincoats.
explanation_ru: После конструкции advise + объект (us) требуется инфинитив с частицей to (advised us to check), а не герундий.

prompt: Rather than hiding the paint tin in the cupboard, Pavel apologised to make such a mess on the hallway carpet and fetched warm water.
answer: Rather than hiding the paint tin in the cupboard, Pavel apologised for making such a mess on the hallway carpet and fetched warm water.
accepted_answers: Rather than hiding the paint tin in the cupboard, Pavel apologised for making such a mess on the hallway carpet and fetched warm water.
Rather than hiding the paint tin in the cupboard, Pavel apologised for having made such a mess on the hallway carpet and fetched warm water.
explanation_ru: Глагол apologise требует предлога for и герундия (apologised for making), а инфинитив с to (to make) — типичная ошибка.

prompt: Niamh noticed we were lost and said, “Shall I check the footpath on my offline map for you?” Which sentence reports this accurately?
options: Niamh insisted on checking the footpath on her offline map.
Niamh offered checking the footpath on her offline map.
Niamh offered to check the footpath on her offline map.
Niamh advised us to check the footpath on her offline map.
explanation_ru: Вопрос «Shall I...» выражает предложение помощи и передаётся через offer + to-infinitive (offered to check). Вариант с checking неверен грамматически, а insisted и advised искажают смысл.

prompt: The guide told us, “The stone path leads to the bay.” → The guide explained …
answer: The guide explained that the stone path led to the bay.
accepted_answers: The guide explained that the stone path led to the bay.
The guide explained the stone path led to the bay.
The guide explained that the stone path leads to the bay.
The guide explained the stone path leads to the bay.
explanation_ru: После глагола explain используется придаточное с союзом that (его можно опустить); глагол обычно сдвигается в Past Simple (led), но для постоянного факта допустимо и leads.
